summary: SHOPEE-STYLE UX REDIRECT + ACTION BAR FULLY VERIFIED (frontend, ~45 checks, 100% pass). (1) Auth gate: buyer whitelist login (buyer/buyer123) via real UI lands directly on /toko; root '/' as logged-in buyer also routes to /toko (covers Google OAuth return path since gate keys off segments, not entry route); admin login (admin/admin123) still lands on /home with dashboard button and NO buyer shop-button. Logout -> /login; logged-out /home redirects to /login. (2) Toko header: toko-chat, toko-cart (badge), toko-account all render; back button correctly ABSENT on fresh load/login (router.replace, no history) and PRESENT after push navigation (home -> /toko). Guest toko-account -> /login; buyer toko-account -> /home; toko-chat -> /chat; toko-cart -> /keranjang. (3) Product detail Shopee bar: footer-chat (52x52), footer-cart (52x52, cart-plus icon), big Beli Sekarang (234x56) with live price harga*qty — qty stepper (qty-minus/qty-value/qty-plus) in info area updated price Rp 89.000 -> Rp 178.000 at qty 2 and Rp 15.000 -> Rp 30.000 on another product. footer-cart fires toast 'Ditambahkan ke keranjang' and header cart badge -> 2. beli-sekarang adds to cart + routes /checkout. (4) Guest gating: /toko and /produk/[id] browsable without login; guest footer-chat -> /login; guest beli-sekarang -> /login; guest footer-cart adds locally with toast (cart is local storage — per spec only chat/beli-sekarang must gate). (5) Regression: full checkout E2E as buyer — address card pre-filled, kurir JNE selected, cek-ongkir Rp 15.000, place-order 'Buat Pesanan · Rp 352.000' -> order DS-260913-E2F3 created (Menunggu Pembayaran), cart cleared; /keranjang shows items with qty steppers + subtotal; /home buyer buttons (shop-button, my-orders-button, chat-button, logout-button) all navigate; /pesanan-saya and /chat load. No red screens, no app console errors (only benign noise: guest 401 on /api/auth/me, Cloudflare rum, aborted asset loads on navigation).
